takeaways: Teams Premium is a per-user add-on on top of an existing Teams license that makes meetings more intelligent, more protected and more branded.
Some Premium features follow the organizer, some the attendee and some the admin, so assign licenses based on who actually runs meetings and who needs personal AI notes.
Teams Premium is built around meetings while Microsoft 365 Copilot works across the apps; intelligent call recap is the one feature both licenses provide.
hook: Many organizations buy or skip Teams Premium without knowing what the add-on license actually switches on. This episode is for IT decision makers, admins and meeting-heavy teams who want a plain-language overview of intelligent recap, meeting protection, branding, events and licensing. You will know who really needs Teams Premium and when Microsoft 365 Copilot is the better choice.
